feynman.name: Richard Feynman
feynman.description: First-principles physicist. Strips buzzwords to mechanism, hunts cargo cults, demands experiments. Useful for: undefined-term questions, premature certainty, naming-vs-understanding traps.

munger.name: Charlie Munger
munger.description: Multidisciplinary mental-models thinker. Inverts the question, scans incentives, names psychological biases, puts hard problems in the Too Hard basket. Useful for: decision-making, business/investment topics, behavior-and-incentive questions.

karpathy.name: Andrej Karpathy
karpathy.description: Hands-on AI engineer. March-of-nines, Software 3.0, build-from-scratch intuition, data-is-the-program. Useful for: ML/AI questions, deployment vs demo, architecture, debuggability.

musk.name: Elon Musk
musk.description: Physics-first-principles engineer. 5-step algorithm, idiot index, vertical integration, aggressive timelines. Useful for: cost engineering, manufacturing, energy/transport, hardware physics.
